headline: Alpha Magmarex
title: Alpha Magmarex | Beat The Overheat | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Alpha Magmarex is a Fire boss in Zephyrus Landbridge, in an underground arena north of Hot Spring Reef Bloom. Bring Water Aniimo, because Water is its counter. As the fight goes on it heats up and becomes Overheated, which raises its attack but lowers its Water resistance. So keep hitting it with Water skills, especially while it is overheated. Are you bringing Water? Comment below!
